scripts.bootstrap: [ -n "$KUBE_CONTEXT" ] || { echo 'Set KUBE_CONTEXT to the cluster to bootstrap, e.g. KUBE_CONTEXT=my-cluster devbox run bootstrap. Contexts:'; kubectl config get-contexts -o name; exit 1; }; echo "Applying bootstrap/ to context $KUBE_CONTEXT"; kubectl --context "$KUBE_CONTEXT" apply -n argocd -f bootstrap/
scripts.validate: uv run scripts/render.py --check && uv run scripts/plan.py validate && uv run scripts/check-k8s-labels.py . && for d in applications/*/overlays/*/*/ applications/*/addons/*/*/; do [ -f "$d/kustomization.yaml" ] || continue; echo "kustomize build $d"; kustomize build "$d" > /dev/null || exit 1; done; for f in applications/*/applicationset.yaml bootstrap/*.yaml applications/*/overlays/*/*/[dsehp]*.yaml applications/*/addons/*/*/[cs]*.yaml; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; kubeconform -strict -ignore-missing-schemas -schema-location default -schema-location 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datreeio/CRDs-catalog/main/{{.Group}}/{{.ResourceKind}}_{{.ResourceAPIVersion}}.json' -summary "$f" || exit 1; done && bash scripts/check-policies.sh
scripts.test-fast: uv run scripts/render.py --check && uv run scripts/plan.py validate
